assets.scope: All files in the pinned robot/robot asset package (including selectable physics variants), plus stairs_160mm.usda. Asset bytes are not copied.

normalizer: Checkpoint runner inference policy; no external renormalization
policy: Mean deterministic action, GRU reset on every done; no training/export

summary.capped_time_definition: First recorded phase>=final_advance time; every noncompletion receives the full horizon, including early falls.
